VERBATIM_RELOCATION.anti_pattern: Ask the LLM to re-emit large code blocks verbatim in a write_file/tool_call. Causes 524 timeouts upstream and risks transcription drift; the LLM may then hallucinate completion.
VERBATIM_RELOCATION.correct_pattern: LLM proposes the structural CUT as a removal diff (small response). A deterministic tool (extract_with_diff) reconstructs the moved code from the diff's '-' lines. LLM never relocates verbatim.

LARGE_FILE_WRITE.anti_pattern: write_file with thousands of lines in one LLM turn — exceeds upstream generation timeout.
LARGE_FILE_WRITE.correct_pattern: Reconstruct large new-file bodies deterministically from an authoritative source; write_file on propose-only paths emits a .proposed artifact rather than discarding content.

HALLUCINATED_COMPLETION.anti_pattern: Declare a plan READY / claim a file was written without verifying the artifact exists with the expected shape.
HALLUCINATED_COMPLETION.correct_pattern: Call verify_artifact(path, expected_shape) after every output-producing tool, before finalize_plan. Fail closed if missing or malformed.

FROZEN_SURFACE_TOUCH.anti_pattern: edit_file / write_file directly against main.py, store/_core.py, chain.py, or any PROPOSE_ONLY path.
FROZEN_SURFACE_TOUCH.correct_pattern: Use propose_edit (existing files) or the .proposed new-file path (new files). Operator applies via git apply.

MIXIN_MISSING_IMPORTS.anti_pattern: Extract methods into a mixin module without carrying the source module's top-level imports. Methods that used module-globals (time, json, hashlib...) NameError at runtime — and import-only integration tests miss it because the error only fires when the method executes.
MIXIN_MISSING_IMPORTS.correct_pattern: build_mixin_module auto-detects which of _core.py's imports the moved block references (detect_needed_imports) and injects them. Integration test must EXECUTE a method (run the domain's pytest), not just import the class.
